## Typescript integration tests: health and flaky-test triage

Every completed integration test run publishes one datapoint per test (TestPassed / TestFailed / TestSkipped / TestDuration) from [upload-integ-test-metrics.py](https://github.com/strands-agents/harness-sdk/blob/main/.github/scripts/upload-integ-test-metrics.py). This dashboard is generated from code in [test-infra/dashboards](https://github.com/strands-agents/harness-sdk/tree/main/test-infra/dashboards); edit it there.

**How to read the per-test tables.** Each row is one test; the value is its failure rate over the window (failed / (passed + failed); a skipped execution publishes only TestSkipped and does not count). 1.00 = failed every run (broken). 0.05-0.95 = flaky. A row showing 0 means no test in that group is inside the band. Tests are split into groups by name token because one widget can only show 500 series.

**Caveats.** Most datapoints come from pull requests, so a PR breaking its own tests shows up here as flakiness; the "merge queue / main only" section at the bottom separates the two. Metric math cannot join a "minimum runs" filter onto a rate, so read the rate tables together with the "fewer than 5 runs" tables. Widgets built on Metrics Insights (SELECT ...) only see the last 14 days whatever the time range says. A test that has not run for 14 days drops out of every table.

### Latest publish
Sums over the most recent hour with data; the sparkline is the last 30 days.

properties.title: Failed, latest hour

metrics.expression: SELECT SUM(TestFailed) FROM SCHEMA("Strands/Tests", Repository,SDK,TestName) WHERE SDK = 'typescript'

properties.title: Passed, latest hour

metrics.expression: SELECT SUM(TestPassed) FROM SCHEMA("Strands/Tests", Repository,SDK,TestName) WHERE SDK = 'typescript'

properties.title: Skipped, latest hour

metrics.expression: SELECT SUM(TestSkipped) FROM SCHEMA("Strands/Tests", Repository,SDK,TestName) WHERE SDK = 'typescript'

properties.title: Datapoints published, latest hour (executed tests x runs; skips excluded)

metrics.expression: SELECT COUNT(TestFailed) FROM SCHEMA("Strands/Tests", Repository,SDK,TestName) WHERE SDK = 'typescript'

properties.title: Runs published per day, all legs and events (TestsRun)

properties.markdown:
### Suite health
Left pair: last 14 days from Metrics Insights. Right pair: 30 days from suite counters.

properties.title: Failed test executions per day, last 14 days (Metrics Insights cap); daily sums track PR volume, not health; read with the runs/day widget

metrics.expression: SELECT SUM(TestFailed) FROM SCHEMA("Strands/Tests", Repository,SDK,TestName) WHERE SDK = 'typescript'

properties.title: Share of executions passing per day, last 14 days; daily sums track PR volume, not health; read with the runs/day widget

metrics.expression: SELECT AVG(TestFailed) FROM SCHEMA("Strands/Tests", Repository,SDK,TestName) WHERE SDK = 'typescript'

properties.title: Pass rate per day, all events, 30 days
Failed tests per day, all events, 30 days

Sorted by failure rate inside the (0.05, 0.95) band; the top row is the worst flake.

properties.title: Top 15 flaky tests, 30 days, browser, agent: failure rate strictly between 0.05 and 0.95 (0 = none in band; check the fewer-than-5-runs table below)

metrics.expression: SEARCH('{Strands/Tests,Repository,SDK,TestName} MetricName="TestFailed" SDK="typescript" browser interventions NOT agent', 'Average', 2592000)

### Merge queue / main only
Pass rate: every run that is not a pull request (merge queue, nightly and release runs). Flaky tables: the nightly run on main only, one table per matrix leg and name group.
